verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a web API for programmatic access, covering account-level resources such as organizations and teams plus data management and export. An official MCP server also exposes searching errors, triaging issues, analyzing performance and managing projects to AI assistants. However, nothing in the pack claims or shows that every UI action (dashboards, alerts, Seer features) is reachable via the API, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, documented API coverage of dashboards, alerts and Seer actions, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness.
